description:
Tracer Twenty5 GT 26" Electric Cruiser Bike in style with the Tracer Twenty5 GT! This 26" chopper stretch cruiser is powered by an 800W motor and features a Samsung 48V/17.5Ah lithium-ion battery, offering smooth rides with a 5-speed motor. Equipped with a steel frame, triple tree fork, hydraulic disc brakes, and FAT white wall tires, it combines durability with retro flair. Enjoy effortless riding with the intelligent pedal assist system, 3 modes, and 5 levels of assistance, perfect for both leisure and long rides.
Tracer Twenty5 DS 26" Stretch Cruiser E-Bike The Tracer Twenty5 DS is the ultimate chopper-inspired cruiser, designed for comfort and style. Featuring a robust 800W motor paired with a 48V/17.5Ah Samsung battery, this bike provides a smooth ride on both city streets and trails. The dual spring fork and hydraulic disc brakes ensure a comfortable and safe ride, while the FAT white wall tires offer excellent grip. With 3 riding modes and 5 levels of pedal assist, you’ll enjoy a versatile and efficient biking experience.
Tracer Twenty5 GTS 26" Chopper Stretch Cruiser E-Bike For those who want the perfect blend of performance and style, the Tracer Twenty5 GTS is the ideal choice. Powered by an 800W motor and a 48V/17.5Ah Samsung battery, this bike features an over-and-under dual spring fork and hydraulic disc brakes for smooth and controlled rides. The FAT white wall tires (26” x 3.0 front, 26” x 4.0 rear) add a bold look while providing great stability. With 3 riding modes and 5 levels of pedal assist, the GTS offers the ultimate in cruising comfort and power.
